plainTranslation:
This person may challenge the way you think. They often bring a different perspective, ask the question you were not expecting, or push back when you assume something is settled.

This can be frustrating, but it can also be clarifying. They may expose gaps in your reasoning, ideas you've taken for granted, or places where you are reacting instead of reflecting.

At its best, this connection sharpens both people. The tension between your viewpoints creates a fuller picture than either of you could reach alone.

The challenge is becoming attached to being right. When disagreement turns into defensiveness, the conversation stops teaching you anything.

The gift of this connection is learning through contrast. What this person questions may be exactly what helps you understand yourself more clearly.
